name: SulcosTransporte-v1
prompt: One modular floor decal game sprite for a top-down painted realistic ancient funerary dungeon, isolated on a truly transparent background. A HORIZONTAL STRIP of two subtle parallel wheel-worn ruts in irregular warm grey limestone paving. Footprint 4.24m long by 0.85m high. The two grooves run horizontally from exact left edge to exact right edge, separated vertically by 0.45m. Old shallow stone wear, dusty edges and broken tiny seams, no metal rails, no wooden planks, no embossed border, no ground rectangle. Make grooves non-emissive and restrained, readable through sparse translucent edge fragments; matched continuation profiles at left and right for repeating strip use, fully top-down orthographic camera with no perspective. Crisp 2D game production sprite, muted hand-painted RPG limestone palette. Transparent space above and below, nothing else, no labels or grid.
